'''Gold Squadron''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|navy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It took part in the [[Attacks on Platform NL-1|Second Battle of the Pakuuni system]], where it was destroyed by [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces.
